title: 正新CST 1922外胎 89块钱215克
notes: Owner post (2024-08-02): C1922 25C 170 TPI bought for CNY 89, about 215 g, not yet ridden. Commenters: several found it very loud; one rode a 23C at 110 psi and found it a little harsh but grippy, with no flats so far; one measured a 23C at about 27 mm outer width on a 19 mm internal rim.
